name: Derivatives Trade Position Set Report V 02
definition: The DerivativesTradePositionSetReport message is sent by the trade repositories to the supervisory authority system, to report aggregated exposures between a pair of counterparties that comprise positions sets, collateral position sets, currency positions sets and currency collateral position sets.

AggregatedPosition.name: Aggregated Position
AggregatedPosition.definition: Representation of exposures between a pair of counterparties that comprise positions sets, collateral position sets, currency positions sets and currency collateral position sets.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
